6 new documentaries on Liberation War screened at Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy
2022-03-30T16:09:28+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/6-new-documentaries-liberation-war-screened-bangladesh-shilpakala-academy-2994011

The Bangladesh Film Institute, in collaboration with Muktijuddho 71, has produced six new documentaries about the Liberation War.

All the documentaries are directed by noted filmmaker Tanvir Mokammel.

Premiere shows for the six films began at Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy from March 29.

The films, "1971 Navy Commando", "Belonia Wars", and "Air Wars Kilo Fight" are slated to be screened today, starting from 5 pm. Other films which were screened include "Bir Chottola Defence Fight", "MujibNagar: Bangladesh Liberation War Government", and "Jonojoddhu '71".
